Authors: Zijian Fu, Xiangyang Chu, Mengshi Qi, Huadong Ma, Guanghao Zhang, Wei Li

Inverting the Bellman Equation: From $Q$-Values to World Models WorldModel

P-learning world model extraction value-based RL goal-conditioned RL Bellman equation

简要说明：本文提出了P-学习，通过逆向贝尔曼方程从基于价值的智能体中提取世界模型，表明在多个奖励函数上训练的智能体隐式编码了准确的环境动态。

TLDR: This paper introduces P-learning, a method to extract a world model from value-based agents by inverting the Bellman equation, showing that agents trained on multiple reward functions implicitly encode accurate environment dynamics.

Abstract: Model-based and model-free reinforcement learning are traditionally viewed as separate paradigms: instead of learning a model of the transition kernel $P$, model-free agents typically estimate value functions tied to a specific policy and reward. In this paper, we challenge this dichotomy by proving that value-based agents trained on a sufficiently rich set of reward functions, e.g. using goal-conditioned RL, implicitly encode a unique and accurate world model. To extract this model in practice, we introduce \textit{$P$-learning}, an inverse analogue to $Q$-learning that samples from an agent's $Q$-values, policies and rewards to decode its internal model of the environment. We then provide sufficient conditions on the type and number of goals for which agents encode the true kernel $P$, covering both stochastic and deterministic MDPs over finite or continuous state spaces. Even when our assumptions are violated, we empirically demonstrate that agents trained on a handful of reward functions encode accurate dynamics in $\texttt{Reacher}$, $\texttt{MountainCar}$ and stochastic variants of $\texttt{FourRooms}$. Surprisingly, we find that policies trained exclusively on a \texttt{Reacher} agent's implicit world model are quasi-optimal on out-of-distribution, velocity-based goals despite position-only training -- suggesting that agents contain hidden generalisation capabilities and providing a new lens into the connection between model-based, model-free, and goal-conditioned RL.

摘要（中文）：基于模型和无模型的强化学习传统上被视为两种不同的范式：无模型智能体通常不会学习转移核$P$的模型，而是估计与特定策略和奖励相关的价值函数。在本文中，我们挑战了这一二分法，证明基于价值的智能体在足够丰富的奖励函数集上训练时（例如使用目标条件强化学习），会隐式编码一个唯一且准确的世界模型。为在实践中提取该模型，我们引入了\textit{$P$-学习}，这是$Q$-学习的逆类比方法，通过从智能体的$Q$值、策略和奖励中采样，解码其内部的环境模型。随后，我们给出了关于智能体编码真实转移核$P$所需目标类型和数量的充分条件，涵盖了有限或连续状态空间上的随机和确定性马尔可夫决策过程。即使当我们的假设被违反时，我们仍通过实验证明，在少数奖励函数上训练的智能体能够在$\texttt{Reacher}$、$\texttt{MountainCar}$ 以及 $\texttt{FourRooms}$ 的随机变体中编码准确的动力学。令人惊讶的是，我们发现仅在$\texttt{Reacher}$智能体的隐式世界模型上训练的策略，在面对基于速度的分布外目标时仍准最优——尽管训练时仅涉及位置信息——这表明智能体具有隐藏的泛化能力，并为理解基于模型、无模型以及目标条件强化学习之间的联系提供了全新视角。

Authors: Alistair Letcher, Mattie Fellows, Alexander D. Goldie, Jonathan Richens, Jakob N. Foerster, Oliver Richardson

Non-line-of-sight imaging with arbitrary relay surface geometries via 3D Gaussian Transient Rendering AutonomousDriving

non-line-of-sight imaging 3D Gaussian primitives transient rendering autonomous driving robotic perception

简要说明：一种利用3D高斯原语和可微分瞬态渲染处理任意中继曲面几何的非视线成像方法，提升自动驾驶和机器人感知。

TLDR: A method for non-line-of-sight imaging that uses 3D Gaussian primitives and differentiable transient rendering to handle arbitrary relay surface geometries, improving autonomous driving and robotic perception.

Abstract: Imaging objects hidden outside the direct line of sight expands the effective field of view and is critical for applications such as autonomous driving and robotic perception. Despite impressive progress in time-of-flight (ToF)-based non-line-of-sight (NLOS) imaging, real-world deployment remains challenging because practical measurements are often collected over spatially limited, arbitrarily shaped relay regions-conditions that violate the planar-wall and dense-sampling assumptions made by most existing methods. To address these limitations, we propose a LOS-guided NLOS imaging pipeline that imposes no geometric assumptions on the relay surface and naturally supports both confocal and non-confocal configurations. Our method represents the hidden scene using 3D Gaussian primitives and couples them with an efficient, differentiable transient rendering model, enabling end-to-end optimization directly from measured transients. We validate our approach on real-world measurements from both a public dataset and a custom-built capture system. Across settings, our method achieves state-of-the-art reconstruction fidelity under spatially limited, sparsely sampled conditions, and significantly outperforms existing methods on complex, arbitrary relay surface geometries.

摘要（中文）：将视线外隐藏物体成像可扩展有效视场，对于自动驾驶和机器人感知等应用至关重要。尽管基于飞行时间的非视域成像技术取得了显著进展，但在实际部署中仍面临挑战，因为实际测量数据通常来自空间受限、形状任意的中继区域——这些条件违背了现有方法普遍采用的平面墙壁和密集采样假设。为突破这些限制，我们提出了一种视线引导的非视域成像流程，该方法不对中继表面施加任何几何假设，并天然支持共焦与非共焦两种配置。本方法采用三维高斯基元表征隐藏场景，并将其与高效可微的瞬态渲染模型耦合，从而实现直接基于实测瞬态数据的端到端优化。我们在公开数据集和自主搭建的采集系统上对真实测量数据进行了验证。实验表明，在空间受限与稀疏采样条件下，该方法实现了最先进的重建保真度，并在复杂、任意形状的中继表面几何条件下显著优于现有方法。

Authors: Yi Wang, Ziyu Zhan, Yuran Wang, Hao Wang, Qiang Liu, Zuoqiang Shi, Lingyun Qiu, Xing Fu

BadDreamer: Transferable Backdoor Attacks against Video World Models for Autonomous Driving AutonomousDriving

backdoor attack video world models autonomous driving spatio-temporal trigger representation-level safety

简要说明：BadDreamer提出了一种针对自动驾驶视频世界模型的后门攻击，使模型在特定触发出现时错误地预测未来帧为空旷道路，从而引发不安全的规划决策。

TLDR: BadDreamer proposes a backdoor attack that poisons video world models for autonomous driving by making them hallucinate cleared future frames when a specific trigger appears, leading to unsafe downstream planning.

Abstract: Video world models are increasingly used in autonomous driving to forecast future scene evolution and provide future-aware spatio-temporal representations for downstream action prediction. In perception-to-action pipelines, these representations can directly influence ego-vehicle waypoint planning, making the learned future dynamics a critical security-sensitive component. Despite their promise, the training-time security risks of autonomous-driving video world models remain largely unexplored. We present BadDreamer, a transferable spatio-temporal backdoor attack that targets the perception side of this pipeline. Unlike conventional backdoors that manipulate image labels, prompt outputs, or action supervision, BadDreamer poisons the learned transition dynamics of a video world model. It constructs trigger-erasure sequences in which an oncoming yellow delivery rider is visible in the observed context frames but erased from the future frames. After fine-tuning on a small fraction of such sequences, the compromised world model learns a hidden conditional association: when the physical trigger appears, it hallucinates a future where the rider disappears and the road appears clear. We further show that this corrupted future-aware representation can transfer to the downstream action module without directly modifying ego-trajectory labels, inducing unsafe non-evasive waypoint predictions. Our experiments instantiate this attack on a representative open-source perception-to-action pipeline, revealing a representation-level safety risk in autonomous-driving video world models and highlighting the need for backdoor-aware validation beyond clean generation quality.

摘要（中文）：视频世界模型在自动驾驶中日益被用于预测未来场景演化，并为下游动作预测提供具有未来感知能力的时空表征。在感知到动作的流程中，这些表征可直接影响自车路径规划，使得习得的未来动态成为关键的安全敏感组件。尽管前景广阔，但自动驾驶视频世界模型在训练阶段的安全风险仍鲜有研究。我们提出BadDreamer——一种针对该流程感知侧的可迁移时空后门攻击。与操纵图像标签、提示输出或动作监督的传统后门不同，BadDreamer污染的是视频世界模型习得的转移动态。它构造了触发-擦除序列：在观测到的上下文帧中可见一个迎面而来的黄色送餐骑手，但在未来帧中该骑手被擦除。仅通过少量此类序列的微调，被攻陷的世界模型便习得一种隐藏的条件关联：当物理触发器出现时，模型会凭空构建一个骑手消失、道路看似空旷的未来。我们进一步证明，这种被污染的、具有未来感知能力的表征无需直接修改自车轨迹标签即可迁移至下游动作模块，从而引发不安全的非避让路径预测。我们的实验在典型的开源感知到动作流程上实例化了该攻击，揭示了自动驾驶视频世界模型中表征层面的安全风险，并凸显了超越清洁生成质量的、具备后门感知验证的必要性。

Authors: Zhe Shuai, Xiaopeng Xie, Yikun Zeng

LOGOS: LiDAR-Only Gaussian Elevation Splatting for Unified Tiny Obstacle Segmentation Perception3D

LiDAR only Gaussian splatting tiny obstacle segmentation elevation estimation off-road perception

简要说明：LOGOS 提出一种无需反向传播、仅依赖激光雷达的高斯泼溅方法，通过自由空间感知初始化和法线感知高程泼溅，在城区与非道路地形中实现统一的小障碍物分割，并保持实时效率。

TLDR: LOGOS proposes a backpropagation-free, LiDAR-only Gaussian splatting method for unified tiny obstacle segmentation in both urban and off-road terrains, using freespace-aware initialization and normal-aware elevation splatting to achieve real-time performance.

Abstract: Robust obstacle segmentation is essential for the safety of intelligent robots, where LiDAR-based perception systems play a fundamental role in the robot-environment interaction. While extensive LiDAR-based approaches have demonstrated high performance on common obstacles in urban scenarios, their results on tiny obstacles such as curbs, gravel, and potholes remain unsatisfactory due to the significant similarity between tiny obstacles and inherent road undulations. Moreover, their segmentation accuracy even deteriorates sharply when the LiDAR scans suffer from degradation in challenging off-road scenes. To overcome these bottlenecks, we propose LOGOS, a LiDAR-only unified tiny obstacle segmentation system, which models the road surface as a continuous mixture of 2D Gaussian primitives and distinguishes tiny obstacles via high-presicion elevation estimation. Unlike existing Gaussian splatting methods that rely on iterative RGB training, LOGOS is a backpropagation-free LiDAR-only approach. It directly estimates Gaussian parameters via a freespace-aware initialization by incrementally pruning non-road primitives using smoothness constraints. Subsequently, pointwise signed distances are computed via a novel normal-aware elevation splatting function, ensuring robustness to both flat and sloped terrains. We evaluate LOGOS on a highly heterogeneous benchmark of point cloud frames collected from urban mobility scenarios and mining haulage off-road environments. These data are practically acquired using different LiDAR sensors and exhibit large variations in point density, terrain roughness, and obstacle types. Experiments on the road and off-road scenes demonstrate that LOGOS significantly outperforms other state-of-the-art methods, particularly in degraded point cloud regions and challenging off-road scenarios, while maintaining real-time efficiency.

摘要（中文）：鲁棒性障碍物分割对智能机器人的安全性至关重要，其中基于激光雷达的感知系统在机器人-环境交互中发挥着基础性作用。尽管大量基于激光雷达的方法在城市场景的常见障碍物上表现出高性能，但由于微小障碍物（如路缘、碎石和坑洼）与道路固有起伏之间的显著相似性，这些方法在微小障碍物上的分割效果仍不理想。此外，当激光雷达扫描在具有挑战性的非铺装道路场景中发生退化时，其分割精度甚至会急剧下降。为克服这些瓶颈，我们提出了LOGOS——一种纯激光雷达的统一微小障碍物分割系统。该系统将路面建模为二维高斯基元的连续混合体，并通过高精度高程估计来区分微小障碍物。与现有依赖迭代RGB训练的高斯溅射方法不同，LOGOS是一种无需反向传播的纯激光雷达方法。它通过自由空间感知初始化直接估计高斯参数，并利用平滑性约束逐步修剪非道路基元。随后，通过一种新颖的法线感知高程溅射函数计算逐点有符号距离，从而确保对平坦和倾斜地形均具有鲁棒性。我们在高度异质性的点云帧基准上评估了LOGOS，这些数据采集自城市移动场景和矿区运输非铺装道路环境。这些数据实际使用不同激光雷达传感器获取，在点密度、地形粗糙度和障碍物类型方面表现出巨大差异。在道路和非铺装道路场景上的实验表明，LOGOS显著优于其他最先进方法，特别是在退化的点云区域和具有挑战性的非铺装道路场景中，同时保持实时效率。

Authors: Nan Ming, Yeqiang Qian, Chunxiang Wang, Ming Yang

Spectral GS-SLAM: Observability-Aware, Degeneracy-Robust Tracking for Real-Time 3D Gaussian Splatting SLAM Perception3D

3D Gaussian Splatting SLAM observability-aware tracking degeneracy-robust ICP and feature matching real-time robotics

简要说明：一种通过结合ICP和特征约束的鲁棒SLAM跟踪框架，利用可观测性感知退化补偿处理纹理缺失和几何退化场景，实现实时性能。

TLDR: A robust SLAM tracking framework that integrates ICP with feature-based constraints to handle textureless and geometrically degenerate scenes, achieving real-time performance via observability-aware degeneracy compensation.

Abstract: Recent 3DGS-SLAM systems enable real-time operation by leveraging conventional feature matching or ICP-based tracking, thereby avoiding the heavy dense photometric optimization used in earlier approaches. However, feature matching remains prone to failure in textureless environments, while ICP-based tracking struggles in structureless or geometrically degenerate scenes due to ill-conditioned optimization. To address this issue, we propose Spectral GS-SLAM, an efficient yet robust tracking framework that integrates ICP with complementary feature-based constraints. Our method mitigates numerical instability by adaptively compensating under-constrained directions in degenerate scenarios, without interfering with the shared Gaussian representation used for mapping. We further introduce a Gaussian-aware planarity weighting mechanism that exploits the intrinsic covariance structure of 3D Gaussians to characterize scene geometry and guide information fusion. Extensive evaluations on challenging TUM RGB-D sequences demonstrate that Spectral GS-SLAM achieves real-time performance (40.14 FPS) while maintaining consistent tracking in both structureless and featureless environments. The proposed method preserves trajectory integrity in degenerate scenes while maintaining competitive performance in non-adverse conditions.

摘要（中文）：近期的3DGS-SLAM系统通过利用传统特征匹配或基于ICP的跟踪实现实时操作，从而避免了早期方法中使用的繁重密集光度优化。然而，特征匹配在无纹理环境中仍易失效，而基于ICP的跟踪在无结构或几何退化场景中因优化条件不良而难以稳定运行。为解决这一问题，我们提出Spectral GS-SLAM——一种高效且鲁棒的跟踪框架，它将ICP与互补性特征约束相结合。该方法通过自适应补偿退化场景中的欠约束方向来缓解数值不稳定性，同时不干扰用于建图的共享高斯表征。我们进一步引入一种高斯感知的平面性加权机制，利用3D高斯的内在协方差结构刻画场景几何并引导信息融合。在具有挑战性的TUM RGB-D序列上的大量评估表明，Spectral GS-SLAM在实现实时性能（40.14 FPS）的同时，能在无结构及无特征环境中保持一致的跟踪。所提方法在退化场景中保持轨迹完整性，同时在非恶劣条件下维持具有竞争力的性能。

Authors: Edward Beng Wai Tan, Siew-Kei Lam, Dongshuo Zhang

A Human-Inspired Thumb-Index Robotic Hand with Strain Gauges Embedded in Soft Joints Manipulation

soft robotic hand strain gauge underactuated tendon-driven grasp adaptation object classification

简要说明：论文介绍了STIR手，一种在软关节中嵌入应变片的双指机械手，通过被动抓取适应和物体分类任务展示灵敏度和安全性，无需外部触觉或视觉传感器。

TLDR: The paper presents the STIR Hand, a two-finger robotic hand with silicone-embedded strain gauges enabling passive grasp adaptation and object classification without external sensors, demonstrating sensitivity and safety in grasping tasks.

Abstract: Human hand grasp adaptation depends mainly on the synergy between physical structure and biological feedback. Inspired by this biomechanical principle, the Safe Thumb-Index Robotic (STIR) Hand was developed as a minimal, lightweight, and low-cost two-digit prototype featuring an asymmetric thumb-index configuration. By pairing an underactuated, tendon-driven mechanical design with flexible strain gauges embedded into silicone-encapsulated soft joints, the system achieves passive grasp adaptation while establishing both internal proprioception and external perception. Unsupervised analysis was carried out on a dataset of the STIR hand grasping 20 different objects, along with an object classification task and an ablation study to highlight the contribution of the soft joint sensors. The object classification task discriminated object size, shape, and material stiffness with a high classification accuracy. In contrast to traditional industrial grippers and robotic hands, the STIR Hand demonstrates that sensorized compliant joints significantly improve overall sensitivity and ensure safe grasping, while remaining independent of additional fingertip tactile elements or external vision systems. Finally, a comparison to similar devices grasping identical objects validates the utility of the STIR Hand.

摘要（中文）：人类手部抓取适应主要依赖于物理结构与生物反馈之间的协同作用。受此生物力学原理启发，本文开发了一种安全拇指-食指机器人（STIR）手，这是一种采用非对称拇指-食指构型的简约、轻量、低成本的双指原型。通过将欠驱动腱驱机械设计与嵌入硅胶封装柔性关节的应变片相结合，该系统在建立内部本体感知与外部感知的同时，实现了被动抓取适应。基于STIR手抓取20个不同物体的数据集，开展了无监督分析，并进行了物体分类任务与消融研究，以突出柔性关节传感器的贡献。物体分类任务能够以高分类准确率区分物体的尺寸、形状与材料刚度。相较于传统工业夹爪与机械手，STIR手证明了具有传感功能的柔性关节可显著提升整体灵敏度并确保安全抓取，同时无须依赖额外的指尖触觉元件或外部视觉系统。最后，与抓取相同物体的类似装置的对比验证了STIR手的实用性。

Authors: Jonas Papenbrock, Shubhan Patni, Tomaso Lisini Baldi, Michele Guerri, Elia Landi, Ada Fort, Matej Hoffmann

Discrete Geometric Modeling and Extended State Estimation of Continuum Robots Manipulation

continuum robots geometrically exact beams Lie group variational integrators extended Kalman filter disturbance observer

简要说明：提出了一种基于离散几何精确模型的连续机器人动力学建模与扰动观测器方法，并在真实平台上验证。

TLDR: A geometrically exact discrete dynamical model and an extended Kalman filter-based disturbance observer for continuum robots, validated on a real system.

Abstract: In this paper, we present a fully discrete approach for the accurate and numerically efficient dynamical modeling and state estimation of continuum robots. The model is based on geometrically exact beams in a minimal, strain-based formulation and derived in the framework of Lie group variational integrators, allowing to preserve important geometric properties that we exploit to achieve high accuracy and numerical efficiency. We then propose a disturbance observer based on an extended Kalman filter formulation that reliably estimates system states as well as model uncertainties and external disturbances. Experiments on a real system validate the accuracy and efficiency of the proposed model and observer.

摘要（中文）：本文提出了一种适用于连续体机器人动力学建模与状态估计的全离散方法，兼具高精度与数值效率。该模型基于几何精确梁的极小应变公式，并在李群变分积分器框架下推导，能够保持重要的几何特性，从而实现了高精度与数值高效性。随后，我们提出了一种基于扩展卡尔曼滤波的扰动观测器，可可靠地估计系统状态、模型不确定性以及外部扰动。实际系统上的实验验证了所提出的模型与观测器的精度与效率。

Authors: Maximilian Herrmann, Leander Pfeiffer, Paul Kotyczka

ReFPO: Reflow Regularization for Flow Matching Policy Gradients RLRobot

flow matching policy gradients Reflow regularization online RL generative control

简要说明：ReFPO提出了一种简单的在线强化学习方法，通过显式Reflow正则化改进了流匹配策略梯度，提升了物理模拟中的稳定性和一步推理性能。

TLDR: ReFPO introduces a simple online RL method with explicit Reflow regularization for flow matching policy gradients, improving stability and one-step inference in physical simulations.

Abstract: We present Reflow-regularized Flow Matching Policy Gradients (ReFPO), a simple online RL method that adds explicit Reflow regularization to FPO for efficient flow-based control. We uncover a key structural property: the gradient updates in Flow Matching Policy Gradients (FPO) can be interpreted as an implicit advantage-weighted Reflow process, providing a new geometric perspective on flow-based policy gradients. Building on this insight, ReFPO introduces an explicit geometric regularizer that can be implemented with a single line of code change without incurring additional computational overhead or auxiliary distillation stages. By synergizing advantage-guided updates with path rectification, our method reduces CFM proxy-ratio spikes, stabilizes PPO-style training, and enables high-fidelity one-step inference that often matches or exceeds multi-step performance. We experimentally demonstrate that ReFPO improves average performance and discretization robustness across GridWorld, MuJoCo Playground, and high-dimensional Humanoid Control tasks, providing a scalable and stable approach for generative policies in complex physical simulations.

摘要（中文）：我们提出了重流正则化流匹配策略梯度（ReFPO），一种简单的在线强化学习方法，通过向FPO添加显式的重流正则化来实现高效的基于流的控制。我们发现了一个关键的结构特性：流匹配策略梯度（FPO）中的梯度更新可以解释为一种隐式的优势加权重流过程，这为基于流的策略梯度提供了新的几何视角。基于这一见解，ReFPO引入了一个显式的几何正则化器，仅需单行代码更改即可实现，且不会带来额外的计算开销或辅助蒸馏阶段。通过将优势引导的更新与路径修正协同作用，我们的方法减少了CFM代理比率尖峰，稳定了PPO风格的训练，并实现了高保真的一步推理，其性能通常达到或超越多步推理。实验表明，ReFPO在GridWorld、MuJoCo Playground和高维Humanoid Control任务中提升了平均性能和离散化鲁棒性，为复杂物理模拟中的生成策略提供了一种可扩展且稳定的方法。

Authors: Ge Wang, Yibo Peng, Fan Feng, Shenhao Yan, Chengsi Yao, Jiahao Yang, Honghao Cai, Yiming Zhao, Xi Li, Jinke Ren, Shuguang Cui, Yatong Han, Zhen Li

Robusto-2: Benchmarking Humans & VLMs for Autonomous Driving in Lima & New York City AutonomousDriving

Visual Question Answering autonomous driving Vision-Language Models out-of-distribution benchmark

简要说明：本文提出了一个VQA基准，比较来自利马和纽约的人类驾驶员与VLM在两地行车记录仪视频上的表现，发现人类与VLM的回答存在分歧，但地理因素并未显著影响答案。

TLDR: This paper presents a VQA benchmark comparing human drivers from Lima and NYC with VLMs on dashcam footage from both cities, finding that humans and VLMs diverge in responses but geography does not strongly modulate answers.

Abstract: As Self-Driving Cars continue to expand internationally and use multi-modal systems such as VLMs as a cognitive backbone for their Action models; how well will these systems generalize in new settings, in particular out-of-distribution (OOD) edge-case scenarios in new geographies? In this paper, we study this open question by providing a full factorial analysis with human drivers of Lima, human drivers from New York City, and VLMs and showing them dashcam footage collected from Lima and New York City -- prompting them with a variety of questions under a Visual Question Answering (VQA) paradigm. In particular, we pick these two cities as they are highly challenging driving locations where no Self-Driving Car company currently operates in, and ask questions that span 4 categories: Factual, Ratings, Counterfactual and Reasoning. We find that Humans and VLMs diverge in their responses -- though this is modulated by the type of questions asked, and that Humans answer similarly independent of where they are from (Lima/NYC). To our surprise, we did not find a strong difference in terms of answers (Humans or VLMs) that was modulated by geography, likely due to their high out-of-distribution nature. Our dataset is available at: https://huggingface.co/datasets/Artificio/robusto-2

摘要（中文）：随着自动驾驶汽车在国际范围内持续扩展，并采用多模态系统（如视觉语言模型）作为其行动模型的认知核心，这些系统在新场景中——尤其是新地理区域内的分布外（OOD）边缘案例场景——的泛化能力如何？本文通过提供全因子分析来探究这一开放性问题：邀请了利马的人类驾驶员、纽约市的人类驾驶员以及多个视觉语言模型作为受试者，向他们展示分别采集自利马和纽约的行车记录仪视频，并基于视觉问答（VQA）范式提出多种问题。我们特意选择这两座城市，是因为它们作为极具挑战性的驾驶区域，尚无任何自动驾驶汽车公司在此运营。问题涵盖四类：事实类、评分类、反事实类与推理类。研究发现，人类与视觉语言模型的回答存在分歧——但这种差异受问题类型调节，而人类受试者的回答表现出一致性，不因其来源地（利马/纽约）而异。出乎意料的是，我们并未发现地理因素对人类或视觉语言模型的答案产生显著影响，这很可能源于这些场景本身具有的高度分布外特性。我们的数据集可访问：https://huggingface.co/datasets/Artificio/robusto-2

Authors: Adrian Cespedes, Marcelo Chincha, Dunant Cusipuma, Victor Flores-Benites, David Ortega, Arturo Deza

Unsupervised Domain Adaptation for Sim-to-Real Object Pose Estimation with Contrastive Alignment and Pseudo-Label Refinement Perception3D

unsupervised domain adaptation object pose estimation contrastive alignment pseudo-label refinement sim-to-real

简要说明：提出了一种名为CAPLR的无监督域适应方法，用于仿真到真实环境的物体姿态估计，通过对局部姿态敏感特征进行对比对齐和基于一致性的伪标签细化，在多个基准上达到了最先进性能。

TLDR: Proposes CAPLR, an unsupervised domain adaptation method for sim-to-real object pose estimation that uses contrastive alignment on localized pose-sensitive features and consistency-based pseudo-label refinement to achieve state-of-the-art performance.

Abstract: Unsupervised domain adaptation (UDA) enables robust transfer of knowledge from simulated to real environments while exploiting a subset of unlabeled target data to improve real-world performance. Existing UDA methods for Object pose estimation often rely on global feature matching, multi-stage larger frameworks, or image translation pipelines, which tend to overlook the pose-specific information embedded in feature representations. To bridge this limitation, we introduce CAPLR that targets the adaptation of pose-sensitive features in localized regions, ensuring that domain alignment preserves the geometric cues essential for accurate pose estimation. CAPLR achieves UDA with three key components: (1) Efficient Cross-Domain Pairing strategy leveraging intermediate features to identify pose similar image pairs across domains without supervision; (2) Contrastive Alignment to perform feature alignment at localised regions in both intermediate and task-specific representations; and (3) Consistency-Based Pseudo-Label Refinement to improve reliability by encouraging stable target predictions. Extensive experiments demonstrate that CAPLR achieves state-of-the-art performance across multiple well-known object pose estimation benchmarks featuring diverse and challenging scenarios.

摘要（中文）：无监督域适应（UDA）技术能够在利用少量无标签目标数据提升真实世界性能的同时，实现从仿真环境到真实环境的鲁棒知识迁移。现有面向物体姿态估计的UDA方法通常依赖于全局特征匹配、多阶段大型框架或图像翻译流水线，这些方法容易忽略特征表示中蕴含的姿态特定信息。为突破这一局限，我们提出CAPLR方法，其核心思想是在局部区域对姿态敏感特征进行适配，确保域对齐过程保留姿态精确估计所必需的几何线索。CAPLR通过三个关键组件实现UDA：（1）高效跨域配对策略，利用中间特征在无监督条件下跨域识别姿态相似图像对；（2）对比对齐方法，在中间表示与任务特定表示的局部区域同时进行特征对齐；（3）基于一致性的伪标签精化机制，通过鼓励稳定的目标预测提升可靠性。大量实验表明，CAPLR在多个涵盖多样复杂场景的著名物体姿态估计基准测试中均达到当前最优性能。

Authors: Nidhal Eddine Chenni, Arunkumar Rathinam, Djamila Aouada

Reward-free Pretraining for Reinforcement Learning via Occupancy Coverage Maximization WorldModel

reward-free pretraining occupancy coverage maximization resolvent world model sparse reward entropy maximization

简要说明：本文提出一种无奖励预训练方法（ROVER），通过学习世界模型最大化状态占用覆盖，使智能体在下游稀疏奖励任务中快速适应，并在表格和像素导航任务中验证。

TLDR: This paper proposes a reward-free pretraining method (ROVER) for RL that maximizes occupancy coverage via a learned world model, enabling rapid adaptation to sparse rewards in downstream tasks, with experiments in tabular and pixel-based navigation.

Abstract: Sparse rewards pose a central challenge in reinforcement learning, since agents receive no informative signal until they reach their goal. Intrinsic-reward methods address this issue by optimizing non-stationary objectives such as novelty, prediction error, or skill diversity, thereby injecting a supervision signal into the problem. While effective, these methods often require that the extrinsic (sparse) reward can be evaluated -- either online or during offline relabeling of the stored transitions. This limitation is particularly vexing for multi-task, meta-, and continual reinforcement learning, where agents' interactions with the environment are usually reward-free. In this work, we present a method to pre-train transferable exploration policies that rapidly adapt to sparse rewards at downstream task time. Our objective maximizes state-space covering for the occupancy measure, and can be framed in terms of entropy maximization. Its algorithmic implementation, ROVER, leverages recent advances on the operatorial formulation of RL to estimate occupancy with a learned resolvent world model, bypassing common hurdles associated with density and entropy estimation. ROVER further introduces a virtual "sink" state for unexplored regions, balancing coverage of known states with expansion into unseen ones and preventing cyclic expansion-collapse behavior during learning. In tabular and pixel-based sparse navigation tasks, ROVER produces more uniform aggregate coverage and stronger initializations for downstream tasks than standard reward-free baselines.

摘要（中文）：在强化学习中，稀疏奖励构成了核心挑战，因为智能体在达成目标前无法获得任何有效反馈信号。内在奖励方法通过优化非平稳目标（如新颖性、预测误差或技能多样性）来解决该问题，从而向问题中注入监督信号。虽然这些方法行之有效，但它们通常要求能够评估外在（稀疏）奖励——无论是通过在线方式，还是在对存储的状态转移进行离线重标记时。这一限制在多任务强化学习、元强化学习和持续强化学习中尤为棘手，因为这些场景下智能体与环境的交互通常没有奖励信号。在本工作中，我们提出一种预训练可迁移探索策略的方法，使得该策略能够在后续任务阶段快速适应稀疏奖励。我们的目标函数最大化状态空间上的占据度量覆盖，并可以依据熵最大化进行框架构建。其算法实现ROVER利用了强化学习算子化表述的最新进展，通过学习的解算子世界模型来估计占据度量，从而绕过了密度估计与熵估计相关的常见障碍。ROVER还针对未探索区域引入了虚拟"吸收"状态，在平衡已知状态覆盖与未知区域扩展的同时，防止学习过程中出现循环性的扩张-坍缩行为。在表格型与基于像素的稀疏导航任务中，ROVER相比标准无奖励基线方法，能够产生更均匀的整体覆盖，并为下游任务提供更强的初始化能力。
